training_fitness: arithmetic mean of J_GP_v3(i) / J_VNSME_v3(i) over exactly the selected train set
model_selection: validation ratio first; then train fitness, node count and canonical tree, as in the existing protocol
requirements: Each reference is a completed, independently rescored v3 VNSME rollout with a finite positive J.
GP and VNSME have identical input hashes, simulator, scorer, v3 contract, initial locations and simulation settings.
Validation instances are not used to evolve trees.
The existing v2 trainer is not a v3 trainer and must not be run with this draft.
100-order partitions remain proposed under the locked split protocol.
